tellings.question: What do you remember about your wedding day?
tellings.text: It rained all morning, and I was sure the whole day was ruined. Rick showed up with his good shoes soaked through and gave me his umbrella without a word. By the time we came out of the chapel the sun was out. And everyone was laughing at his socks.

tellings.question: What do you remember about Rick and Linda's wedding?
tellings.text: Linda always says it rained, and Rick always says it didn't. The one photo we have shows wet steps and a lot of umbrellas. So I think she wins that one.
